media.description: Media copied back from the backups volume's mirror, or `null` when copying failed (the database is restored either way; see the server log)

400.description: Not a dump in the backups folder, not a Famlin pg custom-format dump, or made by a newer Famlin version

code.description: Optional machine-readable error code. `READ_ONLY` marks a `403` for a write blocked because the server runs in read-only/demo mode (see `readOnly` on `/api/auth/server-info`).

409.description: The server already has accounts, or setup or another restore is in progress

code.description: Optional machine-readable error code. `READ_ONLY` marks a `403` for a write blocked because the server runs in read-only/demo mode (see `readOnly` on `/api/auth/server-info`).

500.description: The database role can't recreate the schema (nothing changed), pg_restore failed, or the migrations failed after the restore (details only in the server log)

code.description: Optional machine-readable error code. `READ_ONLY` marks a `403` for a write blocked because the server runs in read-only/demo mode (see `readOnly` on `/api/auth/server-info`).
